privacy.title: Your data
privacy.stored: SkillGraph stores what you add: your CV, the public data of the GitHub account you choose to import, and your profile.
privacy.used: It is used only to find your skills and the evidence behind them, and to match you with internships. To do this, the text is analysed by an AI model.
privacy.deleted: Deleting your account removes all of it.

problems.url: Enter a link starting with http:// or https://.
problems.end_before_start: The end date is before the start date.

cv.title: CV
cv.hint: PDF or Word (.docx), in English or French.

github.title: GitHub

consent.what: SkillGraph can read the public data of a GitHub username: its repositories, their languages, README files, dependency files (such as requirements.txt or package.json) and how many commits are by that user.
consent.public: Only public data is read. SkillGraph never asks for your GitHub password.
consent.withdraw: You can withdraw this consent at any time. Everything imported from GitHub is then deleted.

github.username_invalid: A GitHub username has only letters, digits and single hyphens, up to 39 characters.
github.confirm_withdraw: Withdraw consent and delete every imported repository?
